result.title: ViLFlow: Parallel Vision-Language Generation with Continuous Latent Flows
result.summary: Vision-language generation has predominantly relied on autoregressive and discrete diffusion models. Autoregressive models generate tokens sequentially, while discrete diffusion models typically predict tokens independently within each denoising step. We propose ViLFlow (Vision-Language Flow), a continuous-flow vision-language model that combines joint modeling of output embeddings with parallel token decoding. ViLFlow adapts pretrained continuous language generation to visual question answering and image captioning through learned image guidance and prediction-aware token decoding. A visually adapted teacher provides image-guided predictions as additional denoising supervision. The denoiser learns to reproduce these predictions directly, retaining one image-conditioned prediction per generation step. We train the token decoder on denoiser predictions and paired reference text to improve the conversion of continuous outputs into words. The decoder can be adapted independently, improving answering and captioning without further denoiser training. For captioning, it also supplies text feedback during late denoising, allowing decoded words to inform subsequent refinement. ViLFlow outperforms autoregressive and masked-diffusion baselines by up to 8.46 percentage points on VQAv2 and 4.50 points on GQA without GQA training. On COCO Karpathy test, it improves CIDEr by 16.25 over masked diffusion and 17.81 over sampled autoregression.

AI.brief_summary: ViLFlow 提出一种连续流视觉语言生成模型：用 flow matching 联合建模输出嵌入并并行解码 token，以视觉适配教师在每步提供图像引导的去噪监督，并单独训练 token 解码器以把连续输出转为文字，应用于 VQA 和图像描述。
AI.relevance_reason: 「连续潜流 + 并行解码 + 图像引导去噪」可与 AR 顺序生成作对照，供核查视觉条件在各步如何注入并更新状态、以及图像旁路是否真正影响词输出；但论文面向输出生成与刷分，未涉及显式 latent 推理状态或停止决策。
